# Abdullah Imdad Lakho

> Portfolio of Abdullah Imdad Lakho, a first-semester BS Artificial Intelligence student at Dawood University of Engineering and Technology (DUET) in Karachi, Pakistan. It covers his education, areas of interest, skills in progress, learning approach, academic achievements and contact details. He is open to internships and collaboration.

Key facts, as shown on the site:

- Name: Abdullah Imdad Lakho (also written Abdullah Imdad or Abdullah Lakho)
- Academic identity: BS Artificial Intelligence student, first semester, 2026 – present

- Location: Karachi, Sindh, Pakistan
- Earlier education: Intermediate at D.J. Sindh Science College (completed); S.S.C.-II at Noor Eastern Collegiate, Nawabshah (2024)
- Areas of interest: Artificial Intelligence, Software Development, Programming, Machine Learning, Data & Analytics, Technology
- Skills in progress: C programming (variables, loops, conditionals, functions, problem-solving logic); AI fundamentals and intelligent systems; maths for computing; data-analysis fundamentals; Microsoft Word, Excel and PowerPoint; analytical thinking, logical reasoning, decision-making, communication, teamwork, adaptability and time management
- Achievements: Certificate of Participation, 15th Maarif Inter-School Maths Olympiad (MISMO), November 2019; Certificate of Participation, ICATS English Linguistics Contest 2020; S.S.C.-II Annual Examination 2024, 884 out of 1100, Grade A1
- Community: interested in taking part in and helping coordinate the AI Community (AICP) at DUET
- Availability: open to internships and collaboration

Contact: email abdullah17.imdad@gmail.com; phone and WhatsApp 0303-3313312 (+92 303 3313312); LinkedIn https://www.linkedin.com/in/abdullah-imdad-lakho-150347364/

Accuracy notes: he is at the start of his degree. He has no professional work experience and does not claim professional expertise. The skills listed are subjects he is currently learning, and the areas of interest are study topics, not completed projects. The MISMO and ICATS entries are certificates of participation, not awards or rankings.
